user.title: Welcome to Pattern Pilot
user.description:
Pattern Pilot watches what people in your home do by hand, learns the routines and later suggests automations. Everything stays local.

In this version it only collects data. Suggestions need about 3 weeks of history.

data_description.history_days: Pattern Pilot keeps its own history, independent of the recorder.
data_description.analysis_time: Maintenance and (later) analysis run once a day at this time.

tracking.title: What to watch
tracking.description: Choose which entities Pattern Pilot follows. Configuration and diagnostic entities are always skipped.

data_description.areas: Leave empty to watch the whole house. People are always watched.
data_description.exclude_users: Actions of these users are not counted as manual actions.

signals.title: Signals in the house
signals.description: Sensors whose values reveal what is going on: a shower (humidity rises), an appliance (power jumps), water use. Only the detected events are stored, not the raw values.

data.humidity_rise: Shower = humidity rise of at least
data.power_step: Appliance = power jump of at least

context.title: Context
context.description: These values are saved with every manual action so that conditions can be found later (only on workdays, only when dark …).
